topic: Coulomb's law for two point charges
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Like/unlike charges; unequal separation and signs
acceptance_tests: Check vector Coulomb force and equal/opposite pair forces; coincident point charges reject

topic: Electric field due to a point charge
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Positive/negative point source; observation at several positions
acceptance_tests: Check E=kq r/r³ and test-charge independence; zero distance cannot produce finite field

source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Single charge, dipole and source-bound line sketch
acceptance_tests: Check tangent field direction, source/sink signs and no crossing; line density remains schematic unless quantitatively defined

topic: Electric dipole and electric field due to a dipole
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Finite dipole axial/equatorial and far-field limits
acceptance_tests: Verify superposition before applying asymptotic 1/r³ law; distinguish exact finite separation from ideal-dipole approximation

topic: Torque on a dipole in a uniform electric field
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Parallel, antiparallel and oblique dipole in uniform E
acceptance_tests: Check τ=p×E and zero-force uniform-field assumption; nonuniform field requires a separate force calculation

source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
acceptance_tests: Check constant potential and E perpendicular to the contour in the owning frame; projection is not a world-angle proof

topic: Electrical potential energy of an electric dipole in an electrostatic field
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Dipole rotated through uniform E; stable/unstable orientations
acceptance_tests: Check U=-p·E and τ=-dU/dθ; energy zero must be declared

topic: Forces between multiple charges, superposition principle, and continuous charge distribution
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Discrete superposition and supplied line/surface density
acceptance_tests: Independently sum or integrate source charge elements; distribution and domain cannot be guessed from a drawing

topic: Electric field on the axis of a uniformly charged ring
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Ring axis; centre, ±axis, near/far limits and axial-field maximum
acceptance_tests: Independently integrate Eaxis=kQz/(z²+R²)^(3/2), transverse cancellation and centre zero; reject off-axis use of the axial formula

source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Closed Gaussian surface; inward/outward normals and enclosed charge
acceptance_tests: Independently integrate E·dA=qenclosed/ε0; a surface is not the source distribution

topic: Gauss's law for a uniformly charged thin spherical shell
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Thin shell interior, just-inside/outside and exterior
acceptance_tests: Check field zero inside, exterior kQ/r² and boundary convention; unsupported thick/inhomogeneous sphere cannot inherit shell law

topic: Gauss's law for an infinitely long uniformly charged straight wire
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Cylindrical Gaussian surface around infinite line; radial direction
acceptance_tests: Check E=λ/(2πε0r) and flux through side/end caps; finite wire ends need another model

topic: Gauss's law for a uniformly charged infinite plane sheet
source_refs: J-PDF p.4 Physics U11; A-PDF p.14–15 Electricity and Magnetism; N-PDF p.5–6 Physics U11
required_variants: Pillbox straddling infinite sheet; both side signs
acceptance_tests: Check E=σ/(2ε0) and jump σ/ε0; a conductor surface has different boundary conditions
